title: ConnectTheDots: Sidebar Node Connection Tool for ComfyUI
summary: A productivity extension for ComfyUI that introduces a sidebar interface for connecting nodes without dragging wires across the canvas. It features a search-based connection system, requires no external dependencies, and maintains full compatibility with standard workflow JSON formats.
research_notes: Implemented in pure JavaScript/TypeScript for high performance; avoids the 'doom scroll' problem in massive ComfyUI workflows.

evolution.summary: Transitioned from an experimental utility to a stable full release in April 2026. Major updates introduced 'Lasers' visual highlighting for active connections and an automatic canvas jump feature for quick node verification.
